name: wps-hide-login
notes: Adapter-authoring probe 2026-08-22: inspected the official WordPress.org WPS Hide Login 1.9.19 artifact (SHA-256 34e99ee6032f5863b278aef690ebbfdb00290beb4eacbdae3ab931eb719b3a58). The range is one patch wide and the settings are security-sensitive, so widening requires a new request-routing exercise.

classes/plugin.php register_settings(), new_login_slug(), and new_redirect_slug() identify whl_page and whl_redirect_admin as the two current single-site settings. Both are sanitized route slugs, read directly for request routing, and are portable authored choices rather than URLs, ids, or credentials. whl_redirect is a deleted legacy activation-redirect marker.

The settings-screen and network-save paths call flush_rewrite_rules(true), while Duo option apply is hook-free. No provider is declared on inspection alone: apply remains promotion-blocked until a clean-target request matrix proves whether a raw option write is sufficient or a verified rewrite flush is required. The network defaults are outside Duo's multisite-refusing v1 contract.
